description: Trace a paged GLEIF Level 2 ownership segment from a 20-character LEI (use sanctions_resolve_entity to obtain one). Direction both walks parents and children separately from the root, never sideways into siblings or co-parents; parents-side placement wins cycles. Ultimate-parent edges are shortcuts, never walked hops; ultimate-only nodes are flagged reachedVia: ultimate. Drain nextCursor with the same query, then re-root each boundary with its LEI, same-side direction and depth, including at depth five; deduplicate branch roots and edges across segments. Pages emit nodes, then edges, then boundaries, up to limit records (50 default, 100 maximum), stopping after an intact record reaches the soft 64-KiB target. Edges reference nodes across assembled pages. Cursors bind query and topology; changed topology requires restarting without a cursor. Entity and screening values read current mirrors, not an immutable snapshot. Set screenNodes to cross-reference only this page of nodes as sanctions_get_entity does: legal, other and transliterated names strict (exact then all tokens present, never fuzzy), LEI and country-matched registration number as exact non-document identifiers, with merged designation hits and matchedOn inputs. A node missing Level 1 is screened by LEI alone. Every hit is a candidate to verify; no hit is a clearance. Each eligible node retains direct and ultimate parentStatus: relationship, reporting exception and its reasons, none, or unknown when exceptions are not loaded. Read hasMore and truncationReasons separately from segment-wide missingEntityCount and page-local missingEntityLeis, screening counts and per-node ten-hit cap disclosures. A screening aid, not a compliance determination; a finished segment never proves full beneficial ownership.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the preceding page, with the same query parameters. Omit to start a new segment.

depth.description: Maximum traversal depth from the root entity (1–5), on each side of a both walk. Ultimate-parent edges do not count as hops.

direction.description: Walk parents (who owns it), children (what it owns), or both (default): a parents walk plus a children walk from the root, each to depth, never into siblings or co-parents.

lei.description: The 20-character GLEIF LEI at the root of the ownership graph.

limit.description: Maximum records across nodes, edges and boundaries per page (default 50, requests above 100 clamp with notice).

screenNodes.description: When true, cross-reference every returned node on this page against all watchlists: legal, other and transliterated names strict, LEI and country-matched registration number as identifiers. A node missing Level 1 has only its LEI lookup. Edge/boundary-only pages screen zero nodes.

name: sanctions_trace_ownership

boundaries.description: This page of omitted branch roots; trace each LEI with its direction and depth after draining this segment.

items.description: One omitted same-side branch, with executable inputs for a new trace segment.

depth.description: Depth to pass to the new trace; its root restarts at depth zero.

direction.description: Walk only this side in the new segment.

lei.description: Re-root this LEI to retrieve the omitted branch.

reason.description: Why the original segment stopped this branch.

byteTargetExceeded.description: Serialized structuredContent plus content exceeds the soft 64-KiB target; indivisible records are retained intact.

caveat.description: Decision-support caveat — node screening is an aid, not a determination.

complete.description: Last page, no omitted branches, and missingEntityCount is zero. Check parentStatus for unknown parents. A finished segment does not establish full beneficial ownership.

edges.description: This page of directed edges. Endpoints refer to nodes in the assembled segment across pages, not necessarily this page.

items.description: One directed ownership edge (child is consolidated by parent).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_cursor`: The cursor is corrupt, outside the stream, or belongs to different query parameters. `stale_cursor`: The recomputed segment topology differs from the cursor topology. `lei_not_found`: No GLEIF entity in the mirror carries the root LEI, and its check digits are valid. `invalid_lei_checksum`: No GLEIF entity in the mirror carries the root LEI, and its ISO 17442 check digits fail. `mirror_not_ready`: The GLEIF (LEI) mirror has never completed an initial sync. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

flaggedNodeCount.description: How many screened nodes on this page had at least one potential watchlist match.

hasMore.description: More records remain in this segment; false does not imply complete ownership.

missingEntityCount.description: Number of nodes absent from Level 1 across the entire segment, including earlier and later pages.

missingEntityLeis.description: Page-local missing Level 1 nodes. They show their LEI as a name placeholder and omit jurisdiction/status. The LEI is looked up as an identifier, nothing else, so screenedInputs is empty. missingEntityCount spans the segment.

nextCursor.description: Continue this segment with the same query and this cursor; absent on its last page.

nodes.description: This page of entities, ordered by depth then LEI. The root appears once, on the initial page.

items.description: One entity in the ownership graph.

depth.description: Breadth-first hops from root (0), excluding ultimate edges. An ultimate-only node counts its shortcut as one hop, possibly shorter than the direct chain.

legalName.description: The node's legal name (the LEI itself if not hydrated).

parentStatus.description: Direct and ultimate accounting-consolidation parent disclosures. Present only where the parents or both walk read parents before the depth limit.

direct.description: What GLEIF publishes about the direct parent.

exceptionReasons.description: Every reason given in the reporting exception (e.g. NATURAL_PERSONS, NON_CONSOLIDATING, NO_KNOWN_PERSON). Present only when status is exception.

status.description: relationship = a Level 2 relationship at this level is published — it is in edges when that parent is also a node of this graph (a flagged leaf's parents and a children-side node's other parents are read for this status, never walked); exception = the entity filed a GLEIF reporting exception instead of naming this parent; none = GLEIF publishes neither; unknown = no relationship is published and reporting exceptions are not loaded in the mirror, so whether one was filed is unknown.

ultimate.description: What GLEIF publishes about the ultimate parent.

exceptionReasons.description: Every reason given in the reporting exception (e.g. NATURAL_PERSONS, NON_CONSOLIDATING, NO_KNOWN_PERSON). Present only when status is exception.

status.description: relationship = a Level 2 relationship at this level is published — it is in edges when that parent is also a node of this graph (a flagged leaf's parents and a children-side node's other parents are read for this status, never walked); exception = the entity filed a GLEIF reporting exception instead of naming this parent; none = GLEIF publishes neither; unknown = no relationship is published and reporting exceptions are not loaded in the mirror, so whether one was filed is unknown.

reachedVia.description: Present for a node reached only by an ultimate shortcut. Its side stops here; omitted links set truncated. Increasing depth helps only if a direct chain from the root exists.

role.description: root = the traced entity; parent = an ancestor, reached by walking parents; child = a descendant, reached by walking children. On a both walk, the side that reached the node — siblings and co-parents are never walked.

sanctionsHits.description: Per-node cross-reference results, one hit per designation (an OFAC party both OFAC lists publish once) — exact name and identifier matches first, then strong name matches. Present only when screenNodes is true.

items.description: A potential watchlist match on this node — verify, do not assume.

matchType.description: Exact or strong, never approximate. Absent for identifier-only hits.

matchedIdentifiers.description: Published identifiers matching the LEI or country-matched registration number. Absent for name-only hits.

items.description: An identifier the designation publishes that equals the entity's LEI, or its registration number published for the country of its legal jurisdiction.

country.description: Issuing country as published, when published.

type.description: Identifier label as the list publishes it (e.g. Legal Entity Number, Registration Number).

matchedName.description: Strongest matching designation name or alias. Absent for identifier-only hits.

matchedOn.description: All matching name and identifier inputs, in screening order. Missing Level 1 nodes match only by LEI.

items.description: One value of the entity the cross-reference screened.

input.description: Which value: legal_name, or other_name (an other or transliterated name), each screened as a name, strict; lei, or registration_number (the ID at the registration authority), each looked up as a non-document identifier.

nameType.description: GLEIF's type for an other_name (e.g. TRADING_OR_OPERATING_NAME, AUTO_ASCII_TRANSLITERATED_LEGAL_NAME), or UNKNOWN for a name the mirror stored without one. Present on other_name only.

value.description: The value as GLEIF publishes it.

primaryName.description: Primary published name of the designation.

score.description: Never set here: the cross-reference uses strict matching.

source.description: Source of primaryName. Grouped OFAC hits use SDN unless Consolidated matched alone or better. Evidence and sources cover both records.

sourceEntryId.description: Source entry ID — pass to sanctions_get_designation.

sources.description: Every screened list this candidate is on, in list order: one list, or ofac_sdn and ofac_consolidated together for an OFAC party both OFAC lists publish under one entry ID — one hit, not two. Read this, not source, for every list; the entry ID resolves in sanctions_get_designation under each.

sanctionsScreen.description: Per-node coverage and cap disclosure, present only when screened.

hasMore.description: True if capped. Recover via sanctions_screen_name for names and sanctions_screen_identifier for LEI and registration number. For a missing Level 1 node, look up only its LEI.

screenedInputs.description: Inputs beyond legal name and LEI: other and transliterated names, then a published registration number with jurisdiction, excluding placeholders such as N/A. Empty with no extras or no Level 1 record.

items.description: One value of the entity the cross-reference screened.

input.description: Which value: legal_name, or other_name (an other or transliterated name), each screened as a name, strict; lei, or registration_number (the ID at the registration authority), each looked up as a non-document identifier.

nameType.description: GLEIF's type for an other_name (e.g. TRADING_OR_OPERATING_NAME, AUTO_ASCII_TRANSLITERATED_LEGAL_NAME), or UNKNOWN for a name the mirror stored without one. Present on other_name only.

value.description: The value as GLEIF publishes it.

totalAvailable.description: Distinct designations before this node’s cap, grouping duplicate OFAC parties.

totalAvailableBasis.description: Always exact: all strict name and exact identifier hits are counted.

notice.description: Input normalization notice when limit was clamped.

reportingExceptionsLoaded.description: Whether GLEIF reporting exceptions are loaded in the mirror. When false, a node's parent level with no published relationship reads unknown rather than exception or none.

rootLei.description: The LEI the traversal started from.

screenedNodeCount.description: How many nodes on this page were screened (zero on edge/boundary-only pages).

screeningStatus.description: screened = all page nodes screened (zero on edge-only pages); not_requested = screenNodes false; not_ready = mirror never synced and absence of hits is inconclusive.

totalAvailable.description: Exact number of stream records in this segment: nodes plus edges plus boundaries.

totalAvailableBasis.description: The entire segment topology was enumerated to count its records.

truncated.description: More pages or omitted branches. Drain nextCursor, then re-root each boundary with its LEI, side and depth, including depth five. An ultimate shortcut counts only if its far node is absent; siblings and co-parents are excluded.

truncationReasons.description: Independent reasons the current response is partial: remaining pages or omitted branches.
